pcs.pc_description: plan machining operations for tools & die manufacturing on the basis of drawing/blue print
ensure that the components used are free from foreign objects, dirt or other contamination
prepare and maintain the work area as per procedure or operation specification
confirm with the machine setter that the machine is ready for production
ensure that machine guards are in place and are correctly adjusted
identify and fix different types of cutters or cutting tools in the CNC or conventional machines required for various machining operations
clamp the workpiece securely and without distortion in a chuck/work holding device such as vice, V-block, clamp, angle plate, etc.

• ensure that machine settings are adjusted as per SOP to maintain the required accuracy and quality standards • Quality standards: components to be free from false tool cuts, burrs and sharp edges; dimensional tolerance 0.020 to 0.030 mm; flatness and squareness within 0.125mm; surface finish 63in or 1.6m; angles within +/- 1 degree
measure and mark reference points/cutting lines on the metal blocks by using appropriate marking and measuring tools
lift the metal blocks manually or by hoist and place the same securely on the working platform as indicated in the drawing/work instructions
cut the metal blocks into required size by using power operated/manual/automatic cutting tools as per the requirement
perform rough machining for initial block sizing of work piece
ensure that the right programme is selected in the CNC machine as defined in the SOP
perform various machining operations such as drilling, boring, grinding, turning, milling etc. on the metal block to get the shape and dimension as per the drawing/work order
operate the machine controls in both hand and power modes

produce components as per given quality standards e.g. components to be free from false tool cuts, burrs and sharp edges; dimensional tolerance 0.020 to 0.030 mm; flatness and squareness within 0.125mm; surface finish 63in or 1.6m; angles within +/- 1 degree, etc.
cut, shape and trim the metal block to specified lengths and shapes by using CNC machines
apply cutting fluids with regard to a range of different materials
monitor the process parameters by reading the various gauges and correct them if not within standards
monitor the machine operations for any malfunctions/defects in the component and inform the supervisor/maintenance team for correction
measure the machined pieces and compare with the dimensions as prescribed in the work order and engineering drawing
shut down the machine to a safe condition on completion of the machining activities
check the machined components for any defects and required quality standards
segregate the machines components in to Ok pieces, defective pieces which can be repaired/reworked and pieces that are beyond repair
maintain and update all the records and reports related to production of tools and die as per the organisational guidelines
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
report any difficulties or problems that may arise with the machining activities, and carry out any agreed actions

pcs.pc_description: plan assembling operations for tools & die manufacturing on the basis of drawing/blue print
prepare the work area for the assembling operations as per procedure or operational specification
select standard and specialized measuring instruments based on tolerances required and take measurements of tools and die components
compare measurements to drawings and sketches to ensure conformity, fits and clearances
record critical dimensions as required by workplace procedures
lift the work pieces manually or by hoist and place the same securely on the designated slot/space as indicated in the drawing/work instructions

fasten components permanently by using engineered fasteners, applying adhesives, soldering and brazing
produce mechanical assemblies by combining the components as per job specifications
dismantle mechanical assemblies without damage to components and/or subassemblies
deal promptly and effectively with problems within their control, and seek help and guidance from the relevant people if they have problems that they cannot resolve

perform necessary quality checks or tests for correct assembly parameters and functioning of the tool and die
use the appropriate measuring equipment for checking activities

produce components within all of the applying quality standards (Quality standards: omponents to be free from false tool cuts, burrs and sharp edges; dimensional tolerance +/-0.020mm; flatness and squareness 0.05mm; angles within +/- 1 degree; screw threads to fit as per standard; reamed and bored holes within interference: - 0.025mm (hole) + 0.025mm (shaft), transition: - 0.1mm (hole)+ 0.1 (shaft) , clearance: 50microns; radius: 0.5 r; surface finish 1.6 m)
prepare inspection and work completion reports for the higher authorities
clean and store all the tools, machine and equipment after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
